blocks.label: [A]
blocks.title: Bridges for Animals
blocks.body:
When new roads are built through forests, wild animals are often in danger. Deer, bears, and other animals try to cross the roads to find food or partners, and many of them are hit by cars. Accidents like these ( 18 ) as well, because drivers can be badly hurt.
To solve this problem, some countries have built special bridges for animals. These bridges are covered with soil, grass, and trees, so they look like part of the forest. At first, some people ( 19 ). However, cameras showed that many kinds of animals, from small mice to large bears, began using them within a few years.
These bridges are expensive to build. ( 20 ), many experts say they are worth the cost. In one national park in Canada, accidents involving large animals fell by more than 80 percent after bridges and fences were added.

qs.ex: as well(〜もまた)と、直後の「運転手が大けがをすることがある」から、事故は「人にとっても危険」。

o: doubted that animals would use them
qs.ex: However のあとで「多くの動物が使い始めた」とあるので、最初は「動物が使うか疑っていた」。
「建設費が高い」→「それでも、費用をかける価値がある」という逆接なので Even so。

blocks.label: [B]
blocks.title: Farms Inside Buildings
blocks.body:
In some big cities, vegetables are now grown inside buildings. These "vertical farms" have many shelves stacked on top of each other, and the plants are grown under special LED lights instead of sunlight. Because the plants are grown indoors, farmers ( 21 ). They can grow lettuce in winter, during heavy rain, or even in a desert.
Vertical farms also use much less water than traditional farms. The water is ( 22 ), so very little is wasted. In addition, no chemicals are needed to kill insects, because insects cannot get into the building.
However, vertical farms use a lot of electricity for their lights and air conditioning. For this reason, ( 23 ). At the moment, most vertical farms grow leafy vegetables, which grow quickly and can be sold at a good price.

o: do not have to worry about the weather
qs.ex: 屋内なので、冬や大雨でも育てられる=「天気を気にしなくてよい」。
「ほとんどむだにならない」ので、水は「何度も再利用される」。

o: they are becoming cheaper every year
they are only built in the countryside
farmers do not need any money
growing some crops this way is too expensive
qs.ex: 電気をたくさん使う→「この方法で育てるには高すぎる作物もある」→だから早く育って高く売れる葉物野菜が中心、という流れです。

blocks.label: [A]
blocks.body:
From: Megan Clark
To: Daniel Ito
Date: June 12
Subject: Summer volunteer program

Hi Daniel,
Thank you for signing up for the summer volunteer program at Lakeside Aquarium. We are happy that you want to help us. As we talked about on the phone, you will work at the touch pool, where children can touch sea stars and other small sea animals. Your job will be to explain to visitors how to touch the animals gently.
Before you start, you need to come to a training session on July 2. It will be held from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. in the meeting room next to the gift shop. Lunch will be provided, but please bring your own water bottle. During the training, our staff will teach you about the animals and how to take care of them.
Also, please remember that all volunteers must wear the blue T-shirt with the aquarium's logo. We will give you two T-shirts on the day of the training. If you have any questions, please send me an email.
Best wishes,
Megan Clark
Volunteer Coordinator, Lakeside Aquarium

qs.q: What will Daniel do as a volunteer?
o: Sell goods at the gift shop.
Explain how to touch the animals.
qs.ex: Your job will be to explain to visitors how to touch the animals gently. とあります。

qs.q: What should Daniel bring to the training session?
qs.ex: Lunch will be provided, but please bring your own water bottle. 昼食は出るので水筒だけです。

o: Children will visit the aquarium for free.
qs.ex: We will give you two T-shirts on the day of the training. 研修の日=7月2日です。

blocks.label: [B]
blocks.title: Taking Off into the Wind
blocks.body:
Have you ever noticed that airplanes at an airport sometimes take off in one direction and sometimes in the opposite direction? This is not because pilots like to change. Airplanes almost always take off and land facing into the wind.
An airplane can fly because air moves quickly over its wings and lifts it up. What matters is not how fast the plane moves over the ground, but how fast air passes over its wings. When a plane takes off into a strong wind, air is already moving toward the wings. As a result, the plane can leave the ground at a lower speed and after a shorter run.
Landing works in the same way. A plane that lands into the wind touches the ground more slowly, so it can stop in a shorter distance. This is safer for everyone on board.
Because of this, many airports have runways that point in the direction of the most common winds in that area. Air traffic controllers check the wind all day, and when its direction changes, they may tell pilots to use the runway from the other end. Strong winds that blow across a runway from the side are one of the most difficult conditions for pilots.

qs.q: Why do airplanes at an airport sometimes take off in the opposite direction?
o: They take off facing into the wind.
The runway is repaired every day.
Some planes are faster than others.
qs.ex: Airplanes almost always take off and land facing into the wind. 風の向きが変わると方向も変わります。

qs.q: What lifts an airplane into the air?
o: The speed of the plane over the ground.
Air moving quickly over its wings.
qs.ex: air moves quickly over its wings and lifts it up とあります。地面に対する速さではありません。

qs.q: When a plane takes off into a strong wind,
o: it can leave the ground at a lower speed.
qs.ex: the plane can leave the ground at a lower speed and after a shorter run とあります。

qs.q: Why is landing into the wind safer?
o: The pilot can see the runway better.
The plane can stop in a shorter distance.
qs.ex: it can stop in a shorter distance とあります。

qs.q: Which of the following statements is true?
o: Runways are built in random directions.
Air traffic controllers check the wind all day.
Winds from the side make landing easier.
Planes always use the same end of a runway.
qs.ex: Air traffic controllers check the wind all day とあります。横風はむしろ最も難しい条件の一つです。

parts.prompt:
以下の英文を読んで、その内容を英語で要約し、解答欄に記入しなさい。
語数の目安は25語〜35語です。
parts.body:
These days, more and more people are using car-sharing services instead of owning their own cars. Users register online and can borrow a car parked nearby for a few hours whenever they need one.
One advantage is that users do not have to pay for things like parking, insurance, and repairs. Also, if fewer people own cars, there will be less traffic in cities.
However, car-sharing also has some problems. On busy days such as weekends, users sometimes cannot find a car when they want one. In addition, cars are not always kept clean by the people who used them before.
rules: 解答は、英文要約の解答欄に書きなさい。なお、解答欄の外に書かれたものは採点されません。
要約の内容が英文から逸れていると判断された場合は、0点と採点されることがあります。英文をよく読んでから答えてください。
parts.model: More people now use car-sharing instead of owning cars. It saves money on parking and repairs and can reduce traffic. However, cars are sometimes unavailable on busy days and may not be clean.
checks: 第1段落(車を持たずにカーシェアを使う人が増えている)の内容が入っている
第2段落(良い点:費用が少ない・渋滞が減る)の内容が入っている
第3段落(悪い点:混む日に借りられない・汚れていることがある)の内容が入っている
本文の文をそのまま写さず、自分の言葉で短くまとめている
語数が25〜35語になっている
parts.title: ライティング(英文要約)

parts.prompt:
以下のQUESTIONについて、あなたの意見とその理由を2つ書きなさい。

QUESTION
Do you think students should clean their own classrooms?
rules: 語数の目安は50語〜60語です。
理由は2つ書きましょう。
QUESTIONに答えていない場合や、内容がQUESTIONからずれている場合は、0点と採点されることがあります。
parts.model: I think students should clean their own classrooms. First, cleaning teaches students to take care of the places they use every day, so they will be more careful not to make them dirty. Second, working together with classmates helps students learn teamwork and responsibility. For these reasons, I think it is a good custom.
checks: 最初に賛成か反対かをはっきり書いている
理由に具体的な説明がある
語数が50〜60語になっている
スペルや文法のミスがない
parts.title: ライティング(英作文)

lines: Excuse me. I bought this jacket here yesterday, but it's too small.
Would you like to exchange it for a larger size?
Yes, please. Do you have it in large?
Let me check. Yes, here you are.
items.q: What does the man want to do?
o: Exchange the jacket for a larger one.
items.ex: 大きいサイズに交換してもらいます。

lines: Hi, Tom. Are you going to the school festival on Saturday?
I want to, but I have to work at my part-time job until three.
The festival goes on until six. You can come after work.
Good idea. I'll meet you there around four.
items.q: When will Tom go to the festival?
items.ex: I'll meet you there around four. と言っています。

lines: Mom, can I go to the movies with Jack this evening?
Not yet, but I only have a little left.
Then finish it first. After that, you can go.
items.q: What does the mother tell the boy to do?
o: Finish his homework before going out.
items.ex: Then finish it first. After that, you can go. 宿題を先に終わらせれば行ってよい、です。

lines: Excuse me, how often does the airport bus run?
Every twenty minutes. The next one leaves at 10:40.
How long does it take to get to the airport?
About fifty minutes, if the traffic isn't bad.
items.q: How long does it take to get to the airport by bus?
o: About an hour and a half.
items.ex: About fifty minutes と答えています。20分は運行の間かくです。

lines: Jenny, you play the piano really well.
Thanks. I've been taking lessons since I was five.
I'd like to learn, too. Is it difficult?
It's hard at first, but if you practice every day, you'll get better.
items.q: What advice does Jenny give?
items.ex: if you practice every day, you'll get better と言っています。

lines: Hi. I borrowed a book three weeks ago, and I can't find it anywhere.
I see. If you can't find it by the end of this month, you'll need to pay for a new copy.
OK. I'll look for it again at home.
items.q: What is the man's problem?
o: He wants to buy a new book.
items.ex: 借りた本がどこにも見つからない、と言っています。

lines: How was your trip to Hokkaido?
It was great, but it was colder than I expected.
Not enough. I had to buy a coat on the first day.
items.q: What did the woman do on the first day?
items.ex: I had to buy a coat on the first day. と言っています。

lines: Dad, can you teach me how to make curry this weekend? I want to cook dinner for Mom's birthday.
Sure. Let's buy the ingredients at the supermarket on Saturday morning.
Thanks! Should we practice once before her birthday?
Yes. We can try it on Saturday night.
items.q: What will they do on Saturday morning?
items.ex: 土曜日の朝にスーパーで材料を買います。練習は土曜日の夜です。

lines: Hi, I'd like to make a reservation for four people tonight at seven.
I'm sorry, we're fully booked at seven. We have a table at eight thirty.
That's a little late. Hmm, OK, we'll take it.
items.q: What time will the man's group eat dinner?
items.ex: 7時は満席なので8時30分の席にしました。

lines: Kevin, the art museum is having a special exhibition about Van Gogh.
Really? I've always wanted to see his paintings.
Tickets are cheaper if you buy them online.
items.q: What will Kevin do tonight?
items.ex: オンラインだと安いと聞いて、今夜買うと言っています。

lines: Excuse me, I think I left my umbrella on the train.
The 8:15 from Central Station. It's a black umbrella with a wooden handle.
Please fill out this form. We'll call you if we find it.
items.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?
items.ex: Please fill out this form. と言っています。

lines: Have you decided where to go for your summer homestay?
I wanted to go to Canada, but the program was full.
So I'm going to Australia instead. I'm really excited.
items.q: Why isn't the man going to Canada?
items.ex: the program was full(定員がいっぱいだった)と言っています。

lines: I stayed up late last night to finish my science report.
No, tomorrow. But I have a basketball game tonight, so I wanted to finish it early.
items.q: Why did Linda finish her report early?
items.ex: 今夜バスケットボールの試合があるので、早めに終わらせました。しめ切りは明日です。

lines: Welcome to Green Hotel. How can I help you?
I have a reservation under the name Suzuki. Can I check in now? It's only noon.
Check-in starts at three, but we can keep your bags until then.
items.q: What will the hotel do for the man?
items.ex: we can keep your bags until then(それまで荷物を預かれる)と言っています。

lines: Hey, Emma. Do you want to join our running club?
I'd love to, but I'm not a very fast runner.
Don't worry. We run for fun, not to win races.
In that case, I'll give it a try.
items.q: What will Emma probably do?
items.ex: I'll give it a try.(やってみる)と言っているので、クラブに入るでしょう。

lines: Yuki has been interested in airplanes since she was a child. Last summer, she joined a tour of an airport and saw how mechanics check planes before each flight. She was surprised that they check hundreds of parts every day. Now she wants to become an aircraft mechanic.
items.q: What does Yuki want to become?
items.ex: Now she wants to become an aircraft mechanic.(航空整備士)とあります。

lines: Good morning, passengers. Due to strong winds, this train will run at a slower speed between Oak Station and River Station. We expect to arrive about fifteen minutes late. We are sorry for the trouble.
items.q: Why will the train arrive late?
o: Because of a problem with the train.
items.ex: Due to strong winds(強風のため)とあります。

lines: Honeybees are important for farming. When they fly from flower to flower to collect food, they carry pollen, which helps plants produce fruit and seeds. Without honeybees, many fruits and vegetables would become much more expensive.
items.q: Why are honeybees important for farming?
o: They protect plants from the cold.
items.ex: 花粉を運び、植物が実や種をつくるのを助けます。

lines: Daniel bought a new camera last month. He wanted to take photos of the stars, so he went to a mountain far from the city. However, it was cloudy all night, and he could not see a single star. He plans to try again next weekend.
items.q: What happened when Daniel went to the mountain?
o: He took many photos of stars.
items.ex: it was cloudy all night, and he could not see a single star とあります。

lines: Welcome to the Sunshine Zoo. Today at 2 p.m., you can watch our keepers feed the penguins. Also, the new koala house is now open. Please note that the restaurant near the main gate is closed today.
items.q: What can visitors do at 2 p.m.?
items.ex: 午後2時にペンギンのえさやりが見られます。レストランは今日休みです。

lines: Sakura joined the school's English drama club this year. At first, she was too shy to speak loudly on stage. Her club members encouraged her and practiced with her after school. At the school festival, she played the main character, and everyone was impressed.
items.q: What happened at the school festival?
o: Sakura was too shy to perform.
items.ex: she played the main character(主役を演じた)とあります。

lines: In Japan, many vending machines are designed to help people in emergencies. After an earthquake, some machines give out free drinks. Others have a screen that shows news and information about the disaster.
items.q: What can some vending machines do after an earthquake?
items.ex: some machines give out free drinks とあります。

lines: Thank you for shopping at Fresh Market. Today only, all fruit is twenty percent off. If you have a membership card, you can also get double points on all purchases. The store will close at nine tonight.
items.q: What is special about today?
o: The store is open all night.
All fruit is twenty percent off.
items.ex: Today only, all fruit is twenty percent off. とあります。

lines: Last winter, Noah went skiing in Nagano for the first time. He took lessons from a ski instructor every morning. On the first day, he fell down many times, but he kept practicing. By the end of the week, he could ski down the longest course on the mountain.
items.q: What could Noah do by the end of the week?
items.ex: By the end of the week, he could ski down the longest course とあります。

lines: Camels can live in the desert for a long time without drinking water. Many people think camels store water in their humps, but this is not true. The humps are actually full of fat, which camels can use for energy when there is little food.
items.q: What is inside a camel's hump?
items.ex: The humps are actually full of fat とあります。水だと思われがちですが、ちがいます。

lines: Attention, please. The swimming pool will close at 5 p.m. today for cleaning. The pool will open again tomorrow at the usual time, 9 a.m. The gym and the sauna are open until 10 p.m. as usual.
items.q: Why will the pool close early today?
o: There will be a swimming race.
There is a problem with the water.
The staff are having a meeting.
items.ex: for cleaning(清掃のため)とあります。

lines: Olivia works at a flower shop. One day, a customer asked her to make a bouquet for his wife's birthday. He did not know which flowers his wife liked, so Olivia asked about her favorite colors. The customer later called the shop to say that his wife loved it.
items.q: How did Olivia choose the flowers?
o: She asked about the wife's favorite colors.
She used flowers from her own garden.
items.ex: Olivia asked about her favorite colors とあります。

lines: In some countries, people celebrate a "car-free day." On this day, many streets in the city center are closed to cars. People can walk, ride bikes, and enjoy events in the streets. The goal is to make people think about air pollution and traffic.
items.q: What is the goal of a car-free day?
o: To make people think about pollution and traffic.
items.ex: The goal is to make people think about air pollution and traffic. とあります。

lines: Kenji wanted to improve his English, so he started writing a diary in English every night. At first, he could only write a few sentences. After six months, he could write a full page. His teacher says his writing has improved a lot.
items.q: What did Kenji do to improve his English?
o: He wrote a diary in English.
He talked with his teacher every day.
items.ex: he started writing a diary in English every night とあります。

lines: Welcome to the Science Museum planetarium. Today's show will begin in five minutes and last about forty minutes. Please do not use flash photography during the show. Also, please put your bags under your seat, because the seats lean back.
items.q: What are visitors asked not to do?
items.ex: Please do not use flash photography とあります。座席はたおれるので荷物は座席の下へ。
